offlineDescription: Neither transport is reachable. Outgoing calls queue locally and retry.
rtcDirectDescription: Direct DataChannel between this phone and the desktop. Lowest latency.
rtcRelayDescription: DataChannel routed through a TURN server because direct NAT traversal failed.
wsLanDescription: Same network as the desktop. No tunnel hop.
wsTunnelDescription: Public cloudflared tunnel to the desktop. Adds one hop.
